execution.blocker: Z-Image Turbo native BF16 consumed about 19.4 GB of swap on the 16 GB Apple M5 host; Float8 is unsupported on MPS and Int8 CPU fallback exceeded the preview latency budget.

acceptance.product_fidelity: Exact black-white-red color blocking, Love Hurts wordmarks, hood lining, sleeve stripes, rib trim, pockets, and silhouette match both physical references.
acceptance.physical_integration: Garment follows the model body with plausible folds, occlusion, contact shadows, and environmental light response.
acceptance.optical_realism: No cutout fringe, halo, floating garment, planar panel, duplicated apparel, or pasted-on appearance.
acceptance.promotion_gate: Candidate only until independent visual QA and founder approval.
